summary: Dependency alias redirects 'libsignal' to third-party fork pinned to mutable @latest tag
details: package.json aliases the import name 'libsignal' to the third-party npm package '@bellaxchuu/libsignal-node' pinned only to the mutable '@latest' dist-tag: "libsignal": "npm:@bellaxchuu/libsignal-node@latest". The code imports 'libsignal' at module load time for end-to-end-encryption primitives (SessionCipher, SessionRecord, ProtocolAddress, SessionBuilder in lib/Signal/libsignal.js and lib/Signal/curve.js). Each install resolves whatever the owner of @bellaxchuu/libsignal-node has published to @latest, with no version pin, no integrity check, and no provenance tie to the upstream libsignal-node project. The maintainer of the aliased fork therefore controls arbitrary code that runs at require/import time of this package, including inside the cryptographic session-handling path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
